actors.name: Interchange Format Working Group (21 members)
actors.private_context: Each member has their own schedule, priorities, and level of engagement with the draft revision. Some may be more diligent about returning ballots, others may be less so. No member has a known commitment to return the ballot by the deadline.

shared_context: The Interchange Format Working Group has 21 members. Draft revision 4 has been circulated for ballot. The comment period closes at the hard cutoff: 2026-09-15T23:59:00+00:00. Ballots are returned individually by members. The group has no formal enforcement mechanism for ballot return.

starting_events.description: The comment period for draft revision 4 opens. Ballots are available for members to submit.

resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that at least 14 distinct members (two-thirds of 21) actually submitted a ballot on draft revision 4 before 2026-09-15T23:59:00+00:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
